address_pairs.notes: Taekyung repeatedly addresses Jin-ho as hyung while joking, asking favors, and sharing personal concerns.
address_pairs.speaker: 진태경

continuity: Jin-ho is a civil servant in the Hunter and Gate Management Department and has inferred that Jin Taekyung is involved with the five masked figures' campaign.
Jin-ho agrees to keep Taekyung's identity secret, understanding that disclosure would expose him to danger.
Middle Eastern terrorist groups and Afghan rebel forces have issued a joint statement promising to restrain terrorism, but Taekyung believes their submission will be temporary.
Taekyung's training to complete a new martial result has reached its final stage but remains incomplete because of the heart demon and unresolved grief over Kim Hwajong.
Taekyung realizes that he needs to return to the Murim after finding temporary emotional clarity through his reunion with Jin-ho.
plot: Jin Taekyung returns to his modern-world home and reunites with his older friend Jin-ho, now a civil servant in the Hunter and Gate Management Department. Over ramyeon and soju, Jin-ho reveals that he has correctly guessed Taekyung's connection to the five masked figures' anti-terror campaign, but agrees to keep silent because exposing it would put him in danger.

Jin-ho's companionship helps Taekyung recognize that he came home not only to retrieve the game capsule that first brought him to the Murim, but also to find comfort. Although his training remains unfinished because of the heart demon and his grief over Kim Hwajong, Taekyung accepts that he must return to the Murim and leaves the capsule behind once more.
translation_decisions: Retain Jin-ho hyung as Jin Taekyung's familiar address for his older friend.
Retain Hunter and Gate Management Department for 헌터 및 게이트 관리 부서.
Use Section Chief Kim for 김 계장 and preserve the irreverent tone of Jin-ho's speech.
Retain gongbu as a romanized term when Taekyung reflects on study as the work of mastering something.

active_continuity: Al Diab Jawahiri, the leader of Al-Qaeda, remains in the Skeleton King's custody.
The Skeleton King is an undead named monster who has fought alongside Jin Taekyung and is accepted by Chuck Hagel as an ally.
Al-Qaeda possesses a large Magic Gem research laboratory that appears to have operated for at least ten years.
Choi and Magic Johnson are investigating the Al-Qaeda laboratory and its research results.
Restricted supplies found among the terrorists indicate that someone is supporting or supplying them from within established military, political, or smuggling networks.
The masked group has destroyed terrorist leadership and headquarters while concealing its identities, creating a significant deterrent against further terrorist action.
Middle Eastern terrorist groups and Afghan rebels have issued a joint statement promising restraint after the masked group's campaign.
Jin-ho, now a civil servant in the Hunter and Gate Management Department, has inferred Jin Taekyung's involvement in the masked group's campaign and agreed to keep it secret.
Jin Taekyung's training to complete a new martial result is in its final stage but is obstructed by the heart demon and grief over Kim Hwajong.
Jin Taekyung intends to return to the Murim after recognizing that his reunion with Jin-ho provided the comfort and clarity he needed.
open_questions: Who supplied Al-Qaeda with the restricted equipment, weapons, artifacts, and military goods?
What results, if any, did Al-Qaeda obtain from its long-running Magic Gem experiments?
What fate will the Skeleton King ultimately assign to Al Diab and the remaining terrorists?
Will the terrorist groups' apparent surrender and restraint last beyond the immediate pressure of the masked group's campaign?
Can Jin Taekyung complete his training and overcome the heart demon?
temporary_decisions: Use Al Diab Jawahiri as the full English rendering of 알 디아브 자와히리.
Retain Crazy Korean as Chuck Hagel's address for the masked protagonist.
Preserve Jin-ho hyung as Jin-ho's familiar address.
Keep Magic Gem laboratory for 마정석 관련 비밀 실험실.
